---
title: "Re-projecting MITMA flows onto Basic health areas"
format: html
---

The origin destination data from R package `spanishoddata` are available at the district level, whereas we would require them to be at ABS/ZBS level, we project them using the same approach as Ponce-de-Leon et.al, 2024 splitting each MITMA district
across BHAs by population (GHS-POP 2020, 100 m).

### Access to the data
You can download the projected mobility data directly from this [zenodo link](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23737061). 

In case you want to go through how to create the projected mobility data follow the following steps: 

### Requirements
- GHS population data: because the population grids are large, we dont share the files, so one must download these .tif files for the script to work. You can download the data from  
[here](https://human-settlement.emergency.copernicus.eu/datasets.php)

### Setup

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(spanishoddata)
library(arrow)

spod_set_data_dir("data/spanish_od")
cat_geometry <- read_sf("./covid19-mobility-healthzones/outputs/catalunya/geometry/cat_abs.gpkg")
mad_geometry <- read_sf("./covid19-mobility-healthzones/outputs/madrid/geometry/mad_zbs.gpkg")

```

### 1. MITMA data: connect if converted, download only if not

The DuckDB file is created once (about 17 GB). Every later session just connects to it.

```{r}
db_file <- list.files("data/spanish_od", pattern = "\\.duckdb$",
                      recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

if (length(db_file) == 0) {
  db_file <- spod_convert(type = "od", zones = "distr",
                          dates = c(start = "2020-02-14", end = "2021-05-09"),
                          save_format = "duckdb")
}
stopifnot(length(db_file) == 1)
od_full <- spod_connect(db_file)

# completeness: expect 451 dates, 2020-02-14 to 2021-05-09
od_full |>
  summarise(n_dates = n_distinct(date), first = min(date), last = max(date)) |>
  collect()
```

### 2. Overlay: build once, then reuse

`w` is the share of a MITMA district's population living in a BHA. It is
divided by the *whole* district's population, so border districts only
send their Catalan share of trips.

```{r}
build_overlay <- function(bha, pop) {
  crs_work <- st_crs(pop)

  bha <- bha |> st_transform(crs_work) |> st_set_precision(1) |> st_make_valid()
  mitma <- spod_get_zones("dist", ver = 1) |>
    st_transform(crs_work) |> st_set_precision(1) |> st_make_valid() |>
    st_filter(bha)

  pop <- crop(pop, vect(mitma))
  stopifnot(global(pop, "min", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]] >= 0)

  pieces <- st_intersection(select(mitma, mitma_id = id),
                            select(bha, bha_id = id)) |>
    st_collection_extract("POLYGON")

  pieces$pop <- exact_extract(pop, pieces, "sum", progress = FALSE)
  mitma$pop  <- exact_extract(pop, mitma,  "sum", progress = FALSE)

  pieces |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    group_by(mitma_id, bha_id) |>
    summarise(pop_piece = sum(pop), .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(st_drop_geometry(mitma) |> select(mitma_id = id, pop_district = pop),
              by = "mitma_id") |>
    mutate(w = pop_piece / pop_district) |>
    filter(w > 0)
}

overlay_file <- "data/overlay_cat.rds"
if (file.exists(overlay_file)) {
  overlay_cat <- readRDS(overlay_file)
} else {
  pop <- vrt(list.files("data/ghs_pop", pattern = "\\.tif$",
                        full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))
  overlay_cat <- build_overlay(cat_geometry, pop)
  saveRDS(overlay_cat, overlay_file)
}

# check: ~1 inside Catalunya, <1 at the border, never >1
overlay_cat |> group_by(mitma_id) |> summarise(s = sum(w)) |> pull(s) |> summary()
```

### 3. The re-projection function

M_bha[j,k] = sum_i sum_l w[i,j] * M_mitma[i,l] * w[l,k], written as two joins.
Everything runs inside DuckDB; only the final BHA table comes into R.

```{r}
project_od <- function(od, overlay) {
  ov  <- copy_to(dbplyr::remote_con(od), overlay, "overlay_tmp", overwrite = TRUE)
  ids <- unique(overlay$mitma_id)

  od |>
    filter(id_origin %in% ids, id_destination %in% ids) |>
    mutate(id_origin      = as.character(id_origin),
           id_destination = as.character(id_destination)) |>
    group_by(date, id_origin, id_destination) |>
    summarise(trips = sum(n_trips, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    inner_join(ov |> select(id_origin = mitma_id, source = bha_id, w_o = w),
               by = "id_origin") |>
    inner_join(ov |> select(id_destination = mitma_id, target = bha_id, w_d = w),
               by = "id_destination") |>
    group_by(date, source, target) |>
    summarise(trips = sum(trips * w_o * w_d, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    collect()
}
```


### 4. Full period, one month at a time

Each month is saved as it finishes; months already on disk are skipped, so
after a crash you just rerun this chunk.

```{r}
out_dir <- "data/cat_od_bha_reprojected"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
months <- seq(as.Date("2020-02-01"), as.Date("2021-05-01"), by = "month")

for (i in seq_along(months)) {
  start_d <- months[i]
  end_d   <- seq(start_d, by = "month", length.out = 2)[2] - 1
  file    <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(start_d, "%Y-%m"), ".parquet"))
  if (file.exists(file)) next

  part <- project_od(od_full |> filter(date >= start_d, date <= end_d), overlay_cat)
  write_parquet(part, file)
  message(format(start_d, "%Y-%m"), ": ", nrow(part), " rows")
}
```

### 5. Load the result

```{r}
cat_od_new <- open_dataset(out_dir)   # lazy: filter/summarise before collect()
```


### For Madrid

##preojecting the data
```{r}
reproject_months <- function(od_full, overlay, out_dir) {
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  months <- seq(as.Date("2020-02-01"), as.Date("2021-05-01"), by = "month")

  for (i in seq_along(months)) {
    start_d <- months[i]
    end_d   <- seq(start_d, by = "month", length.out = 2)[2] - 1
    file    <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(start_d, "%Y-%m"), ".parquet"))
    if (file.exists(file)) next

    part <- project_od(od_full |> filter(date >= start_d, date <= end_d), overlay)
    write_parquet(part, file)
    message(format(start_d, "%Y-%m"), ": ", nrow(part), " rows")
  }
}
```

### creating overlay with population data if it already is not done
```{r}
overlay_file <- "data/overlay_mad.rds"
if (file.exists(overlay_file)) {
  overlay_mad <- readRDS(overlay_file)
} else {
  pop <- vrt(list.files("data/ghs_pop", pattern = "\\.tif$",
                        full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))
  overlay_mad <- build_overlay(mad_geometry, pop)
  saveRDS(overlay_mad, overlay_file)
}

reproject_months(od_full, overlay_mad, "data/mad_od_bha_reprojected")
```
